name: Puggle
about: Puggle's parts, where each turns, and her moves. Shapes paint in the order listed. 'stroke' is the dark outline; 'tint' is the outline in the coloured line style. Angles are degrees, clockwise. She has no mouth: her eyes, eyebrows, cheeks, the tilt of her head and her tail show the feeling. Borrowed from comics: marks on her cheeks when she is pleased, eyes squeezed shut (> <), and sparkles or Zs in the air. Her feet are webbed, each on its own ankle so it can lift and flap. What she wears follows the weather: boots, a coat and a rain hat for rain, a scarf and beanie for cold, a straw hat and zinc for heat. Indoors at bedtime she is in her pyjamas.

nod.about: An everyday log was saved: one small happy bounce.

greet.about: Hello: a wave, held at the top, eyebrows up.

proud.about: A potty success: ta-da, arms out and tail straight up, held, then a soft look to end on.

celebrate.about: A milestone: two hops with her arms up. The only big reaction; keep it rare.

wake.about: A sleep ended: a long stretch with her eyes shut, then wide awake.

wag.about: A happy tail, on its own track so it can go with anything.

walk.about: Walking on the spot, a waddle from side to side. Goes round until told to stop.

splash.about: In the rain: a jump into the puddle she is standing in.

celebrate-refined.about: The milestone hops with weight: a dip that widens as it shortens, a stretch going up, a landing that squashes the body and never the head, then a settle. Proposed; not used by the app yet.

oh.about: Oh! A small start, hands to her cheeks and clear of her bill, eyes wide. The one time her hands are in front of her head.

read.about: Reading: a book held open at her chest, eyes down on it, a page turned now and then. Goes round until stopped.

hug.about: A hug for her rabbit: both arms round it, a squeeze, and a sway from side to side.
